name: Qarun
tagline: His keys alone could tire strong men. He said: I earned it myself. The earth took him and his house.
description: Watch the fall of Qarun, scene by scene: the richest man among Musa's people, the advice he rejected, the procession that made others envious, the earth that swallowed him, and what those who envied him said the next morning. Told through the Quran.
outro: The home of the Hereafter is for those who seek no greatness on earth.

lines: Qarun was one of Musa's own people.
Allah gave him so much treasure
that its keys alone were a burden for a band of strong men.
His people warned him: do not exult.
Use what you were given for the next life,
and do not forget your share of this one.
Not Allah's gift. His own skill.
One day he rode out before his people in all his finery.
Others, who had been given knowledge, saw it differently.
It took him, and it took his house.
No treasure, no servant, no friend could hold him up.
The next morning, the same people who had wished to be him
He trusted his wealth to hold him up.
The earth beneath it gave way.
Wealth is a test, not proof of worth.
